messages:
micah: Quick update before we go live  swapping demo and Q&A. Demo now ~10:04, Q&A opens ~10:19. Posting sticky in #lobby in 60s.

anya: Got it. Will post sticky + pin seeded leadership Qs (roadmap cadence, Dedicated SLA timeline).

marco-av: Doing a final audio sweep. Heard a tiny pop on presenter mic during rehearsal. Tightening XLR and will standby with lav B.

jen: I'll be available for the SLA timeline Q&A. No changes to SLA language today; we can clarify rollout windows.

sam: Caption service warm, latency ~1.1s. If captions drop, fallback = post-meeting transcript + highlights within 4h.

lily: Can we tell remote attendees we'll keep captions on and may pause video briefly if AV flares? Saves confusion.

micah: Yes include that in the sticky. Also note: if OBS disconnects, auto-failover to backup ingest in ~20s.

stream-bot: Stream monitor: ingest latency 0.41s, packet loss 0.03% over 5m. Auto-failover threshold configured at 5% loss or >5s sustained gap.

marco-av: Ops fallback plan: 1) quick XLR swap to lav B 2) if jitter >250ms for 30s, switch to slides-only layout 3) if OBS process exits, trigger rehost to backup ingest. Command pinned in #eng-infra.

anya: Sticky posted: "Agenda tweak: demo 10:04, Q&A 10:19. Captions ON. Upvote questions in thread. We may pause video for audio fixes."

micah: Perfect. If anyone needs last-second slide edits DM marco-av with `slide:<num>`. I'll compile Q&A follow-ups after the meeting into #all-hands-summary. See you in 6. :rocket:
